::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Pune fabless firm incubated at the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT, DRDO campus). Develops wireless IP and SoCs for MIMO, satellite communication and Wi-Fi, and also offers ASIC/FPGA design services. No tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Wireless baseband IP cores and custom SoCs/ASICs for MIMO, SATCOM and Wi-Fi systems; verification IP.
